_meta.schema_compatibility_warning: CATS Global Schools is mostly K-12 / Sixth Form / English-language. The existing programLevel enum (bachelor|master|phd|foundation) does not cover A-Level, IB Diploma, GCSE, Year 7-11, US High School Diploma, English-language courses, or summer programmes. Schema extension required before merging into site/src/content/universities/.
_meta.non_duplicates_confirmed: bournemouth.json (Bournemouth University via Kaplan) is NOT bournemouth-collegiate-school (CATS) — distinct entities, same city. All 12 CATS slugs are new to the catalog.
_meta.st_michaels_clarification: Aggregator entry 'St Michael's School and Sixth Form' is the WELSH boarding school in Llanelli (stmikes.co.uk), NOT the Leigh-on-Sea prep school (stmichaels.school). Confirmed via 'and Sixth Form' wording + offers full A-Level catalogue.
